Who's there? ...It's you. What do you want?\nWhen I can complete the sorcery gem?\nI don't know.
The gem itself is done, but I'm not sure how long\nit'll take to raise the power in it to the level\nthat's strong enough to defeat the monster...
I'll do my best to complete it asap.\nVisit me again when you have time. Thanks.
Who's there? ...It's you. Fewer monsters attack\nthis place since I gave you the sorcery gem.\nBut their energy is getting stronger day by day.
The deformed monsters must be trying to break\nMajua's seal and invade our world again...
You still have the sorcery gem, right? ...Alright.\nNever lose it until you fight the monsters.\nI'm expecting you to defeat them.
[ff6464]Naiataaa!![ffffff]
Talk
Quit
High Difficulty Hunting Event
CHALLENGE BATTLE\nDo something about Naiata!!
BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Boss Roga!!
What now?!
An elven woman is yelling something and casting\nmagic attacks...\nLooks like she's Naiata.
Her right ear is gone and her eyes are closed.\nShe's casting magic attacks like hell, so it's\ndifficult to approach her...
You goddamn brats! You can't trick me!!\nGet lost! I said Get looooost!!
W-Why do you cast magic spells like that?!
Hey, Naiata!!\nWe came on an errand for Tecaca!\nHey! Listen to me!
Eeek!!\nShe's totally out of control...
Hey, you! Can you [ffff64]go talk to her[ffffff]?!\nShe can't hear our voices from here.
You somehow dodged the magic attacks and told her\nthat you came on an errand for Tecaca.
What do you want from me?!\n...A bag from Tecaca?\nWhy didn't you say that earlier?! Give it to me!
Oh! That's what I need!!\nNow I can complete it...
Hey, hey. Excuse me?!\nNo apologies after attacking us?!
And you're not worried about Tecaca?\nHe hasn't come back yet, right?\nYou've got no heart?!
...What? I'm busy right now, so make it short.\n...Right. I'm making a holy gem...
No, actually it's a Sorcery Gem made to\nexterminate evil existence. It's got special\nabilities and is more powerful than a holy gem...
S-Sorcery gems...??
Long time ago, Mauez and I lent a hand to Majua\nwho wanted to restore the world to its original \nstate to release the gate of another world...
But deformed monsters appeared at the gate and\nbrought disasters to our world...
*shudder*\nIt gives me a chill everytime I hear it...
We managed to drive them back to another world...\nWell, you can see what I lost then...
I lost my right ear & eyesight but I deserved it.\nI don't regret what I've done because I protected\nthe people in this world...
Still...! The monsters must pay for what they've\ndone to me! Even grinding 'em into dust won't be\nenough! Agggghhhh!
Awww... Hey.\nI guess something is wrong with her mind, right?
As you can see, her passion in creating holy gems\nderives from her kindness towards people in this\nworld, hatred towards the deformed monsters,and...
a cruel mind to defeat them at any cost.\nWhat a complex combination...
Oh, we were thinking about the errand for Tecaca\nall the time but...\nWe need to tell her what Mauez said...
You told her what Mauez the Moon Wizard said...
What the... So, Mauez has noticed it, too...
Only the three wizards know the evil energy of\nthe deformed monsters and it's getting stronger\nand stronger these days...
Actually, I feel it nearby sometimes, and\nthat makes me upset because I can't see anything.
Oh, that's why you were casting magic spells...
I'm not sure when and where but...\nThe monsters will appear soon.
So, I ordered Tecaca to collect the materials to\ncreate special holy gems, the sorcery gems that\ncan be used to defeat the deformed monsters...
...Hm. I've made it this far.
Great... I've never seen that color...
But... It's still weak to drive them off...
Gwa ha ha! I foooound 'em!\nI'll break the stone for our boss!
A puppet of the deformed monsters?!\nI won't let you do this easily!
Huh? I feel itchy.\nIt's useless against me! Hah!!
Agh!!
Ugg... Gha... Gha ha...\nDon't know how powerful the stone is but...\nIt's totally useless... against our boss...
...So, the evil energy I've been feeling\nmight be this one.
It said [our boss] and I guess it's a deformed\nmonster. I don't know how but it may about to\nresurrect...
I'll leave the sorcery gems to you once completed,\nso...
I want you to go to the gate of another world and\ndefeat the monsters... Majua is sealing the gate\nwith his life... Can you do that?
Great. But do not waste your life till then.\nI don't know when I can complete the sorcery gem,\nso you must come to see me often.
Uh... Excuse me, Naiata? Heh, heh.\nI was wondering if you could do me just a little\nfavor...
May I purchase holy gems directly from you?
Talk business with Tecaca.\nThis is a sacred place to create holy gems.\nDo not talk about money here.
Meh! Why is this happening to me...
Oh, hey.\nWe should report about the deformed monsters\nto Pino, right?
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go back to Sofya City!
Explore here a little longer!
Dodge the magic circles and approach Naiata!
...What? You need detox gems? Hmm...\nI'm busy creating the sorcery gem but...
Someone's life is at stake.\nSo, I can't turn it down...
But I need special ingredients to create it.\nCan you collect them?
Very well. Collect the items on this list.\nDon't miss anything.\nMake sure you have all of them. Got it?
That was fast. You cherish other people's life\neven if they are not your acquaintances.\nAlright. I'll get to it. Wait for a while.
Naiata handed over Detox Gem to you!
I've almost finished creating the sorcery gem.\nHave you found the Gate of Another World?
Uh... Um... We're not sure but it might be beyond\nthe fortress which we'll be delivering the gem to.
There should be a great magic barrier around\nthe gate to keep people off.
The gate must be near the magic barrier.\nCome to receive the sorcery gem when you find\nthe gate.
W-Wait.\nWe need to pass the magic barrier to confirm\nthe exact place of the gate, right?
The statue near the magic barrier knows how to\nget inside the magic barrier...
By the way, you are in a hurry, aren't you?\nPeople are waiting for the detox gems, right?
Whoa! Yes!\nBut... The statue knows? What does that mean?
Just go and you will see.\nWatch your step.
Oh, yeah.\nCan I open the reward that the wanderer gave us?\nI can't wait to see the treasure!
Pelulu opened the pack that Balsette gave us...
What's going on?!
You got [★Ethos Fortress]!
Ugg... It's rare but...\nIt's not a treasureeee!!
The fact that you came means you found\nthe Gate of Another World, right? But...
...Look. It's not finished yet.\nI did my best as the Star Wizard but...\nThere's something lacking...
My magic power might have eroded when I lost\nmy ear and sight during the battle at the gate.\nThat might be why I couldn't make it...
Can you deliver it to Mauez and ask him to finish\nthe refinement?
Mauez lost his magic power too but...\nHe is the Moon Wizard.\nHe's more skillful at refinement than me.
I'm not going!\nI don't wanna get screwed again!!
H-Hey!\nD-Don't leave me aloooone!!
After the battle against Nurethoth, you took\nMajua to Naiata but he shows no signs of\nconsciousness...
Hmm... Looks like Nurethoth took a lot of magic\npower and body tissues from Majua to make his\nexistence stable in this world...
It will take a long time to recover...
I have another concern...\nThe evil energy of the Ancient God is gone.\nBut I can feel another evil energy now.
It might have been covered by the Ancient God's\nenergy... Moreover, it's getting more powerful.\nWe cannot leave it as it is.
Can you go find out what it is?
...Hm? But if you ask Pino the Goddess of Wisdom\nfor help before we could identify the evil energy,\nit might expose her to danger.
If you need help, you might want to ask the Elder\nof Resistle in El Scaro.
